title: attestation: Add the TDX family implementation
overview: Implements the TDX attestation provider as a module that registers as a client of the native tdx-guest service (patch 18) and creates a ctlv-attestation-tdx instance per TDX device. It plugs MR descriptions, evidence formats and read/extend callbacks into the base attestation core (patches 15-17) and supplies the hooks declared by the generated TDX family files (patch 19). Kconfig, Makefile and documentation wire it into the build.

files.purpose: Driver-API documentation for the attestation framework.

units.title: TDX provider section
units.summary: Documents MR ID numbering, supported evidence formats and that only <linux/tdx-guest.h> is consumed.

units.title: ATTESTATION_TDX option
units.summary: Tristate option depending on TDX_GUEST_DRIVER, grouped under ATTESTATION.

files.purpose: Build rules for the attestation core and providers.

units.title: attestation-tdx module
units.summary: Builds attestation-tdx.ko from the provider source and the generated TDX family source.

files.purpose: TDX provider: describes the TDX registers and evidence, delegates native work to `struct tdx_guest_ops`, and implements the hooks required by the generated family descriptor. Instances are created and destroyed via the tdx_guest client add/remove callbacks.

units.title: Header, includes and state
units.summary: Includes and the init-info and per-instance state structs.
units.details: `attestation_tdx_init_info` is passed to ctlv_create(); `struct attestation_tdx` is the family priv holding the parent device and native ops.

units.title: MR algorithm and descriptor table
units.summary: Describes MRTD (ID 0, read-only) and RTMR0-3 (IDs 1-4, readable and extendable), all SHA-384.
units.details: Register index is set only for RTMRs; the IDs are what userspace uses.

units.title: Evidence objects and caps
units.summary: Declares the tdx-tdreport-1.0 and tdx-quote-1.0 formats, both binding MRs, and a fixed-size REPORTDATA challenge.
units.details: Sizes come from TDX_GUEST_* constants in tdx-guest.h.

units.title: attestation_tdx_evidence_get()
units.summary: Gets one TDREPORT or Quote into a temporary buffer and copies it into the reply blob.
units.details: Accepts exactly one object; picks report_get or quote_get by comparing the supported_object pointer; writes via ctlv_blob_write() and records the length; the buffer is freed on every path.

units.title: attestation_tdx_mr_read()
units.summary: Maps a provider MR ID to the native TDX register and reads its SHA-384 value.
units.details: Rejects out-of-range IDs and anything but a single SHA-384 value.

units.title: attestation_tdx_mr_extend()
units.summary: Extends RTMR0-3 (IDs 1-4) through the native rtmr_extend op using ID minus one.
units.details: MRTD (ID 0) is not extendable and yields -EOPNOTSUPP.

units.title: Provider table
units.summary: Provider vtable and static data consumed by the base attestation family.

units.title: Family priv lifecycle hooks
units.summary: Core-called hooks: priv size, pre_init returning the provider table, init capturing device and ops, empty fini.
units.details: pre_init supplies the provider before the base family's init runs; init validates the init info.

units.title: Op pre/post hooks
units.summary: Forward family-wide op hooks to the base attestation implementation on the parent priv via ctlv_priv_parent().

units.title: ctlv_attestation_tdx_device_info_fill()
units.summary: Fills the base device-info reply with mrconfigid, mrowner and mrownerconfig from the native info.
units.details: Returns -ENODEV without native info and -EMSGSIZE if any put fails; uses generated put helpers.

units.title: tdx_guest client glue
units.summary: The add callback creates the CTLV device with ctlv_create(); remove calls ctlv_destroy(); both are registered as a tdx_guest_client.

units.title: Module init and metadata
units.summary: Registers and unregisters the tdx_guest client and declares module metadata and namespace imports.
